question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Would you please __support__ me for once in your life?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. refute.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"support"** means to give assistance to, or to back someone or something. (समर्थन करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She always supports her friends during tough times.
 
 
 
• **"Refute"** means to prove a statement or theory to be wrong or false; to disprove. (खंडन करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The lawyer refuted the allegations against his client with strong evidence.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'support'** is **'refute'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. refute.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Disclaim** (त्याग करना): To refuse to acknowledge or deny any connection with.

 
 
• **Example:** He disclaimed any responsibility for the error.
 
 
 
• **Document** (दस्तावेज़): To record something in written, photographic, or other form.
 
 
• **Example:** She documented all her travels in a journal.
 
 
 
• **Establish** (स्थापित करना): To set up on a firm or permanent basis.
 
 
• **Example:** They established a new company to market their product.
